description_en: Queries the list of AI Engine event nodes

name: DescribeAiEngineEventNodes

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the WAF instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF 实例的 ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询当前 WAF 实例的 ID

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used to query the next page. Set the value to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first query
parameters.help_zh: 下一页查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次 API 调用返回的NextToken参数值。首页查询无需传入
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page in a paging query. Valid values: 1 to 20. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页显示的条目数。取值范围为：1~20，默认值为20

The node tag. Valid values:

bypass: Suspected bypass.

protect: Mitigated.

attempt: Reconnaissance and probing

bypass：表示疑似绕过。

attempt：表示侦查探测

OccurredAt.description_en: The time when the node occurred. The time is in the UNIX timestamp format. Unit: milliseconds
OccurredAt.description_zh: 节点发生时间，格式为 Unix 时间戳，单位：毫秒

NextToken.description_en:
The pagination token that is used to query the next page. If a next page exists, this field returns a value.
If this parameter returns a value, a next page exists. You can use the returned NextToken as a request parameter to obtain the data on the next page until no value is returned, which indicates that all data is obtained
NextToken.description_zh:
下一页查询凭证（Token），如果有下一页，则该字段有返回值。
该参数只要返回值，则说明还有下一页。您可以将返回的NextToken作为请求参数再次获得下一页的数据，直到无返回值，表示获取到了所有的数据
NextToken.title_en: 下一批游标，无后续结果为空字符串。
NextToken.title_zh: 下一批游标，无后续结果为空字符串。
